title: October’s Atmos™ Members Day flight deals unlock six charming winter destinations
summary: Through Oct. 10, Atmos Rewards members can save up to 50% on award travel to Helsinki, Munich, Paris, Sapporo, Seoul and Stavanger, where winter is a way of life.
